a: We make the things a local business shows the public: the website, the Google listing, menus, TV boards, signs, ads and social posts. We also build our own software for restaurants, gyms, barbershops and clinics.

q: Where are you, and do you work outside New York?
a: Our shop is in Garden City, on Long Island, New York. Most of our work is in New York, and we work with businesses in every other state by phone and video call. Print ships anywhere in the United States.

Each package has a starting price. Your price depends on the size of the job: how many pages, how many locations, how many screens, how much print. After a short talk you get the exact number in writing, before any work starts.

q: Can I buy just one thing?
a: Yes. You can order only a menu, only a website or only ads. The packages are there because most owners need a few things at once and it costs less to do them together.

q: Do I have to sign a long contract?
a: One-time jobs are paid per job. Monthly work runs month to month, and the terms are written in your quote before you agree to anything.

q: How long does a website take?
a: It depends on the size and on how fast we get your photos, menu and details. Your quote gives a date, and we tell you early if anything moves.

q: Who owns the website when it is done?
a: You do. Your domain name, your words and your photos stay yours.

q: Are the brands on this page real businesses?
a: No. Marlow’s Slice House, Sunrise Bagel Co. and the others are brands we made up and designed ourselves, to show what a full kit looks like. The software is real: we built it and it runs today.

q: Can you do the printing too?
a: Yes. We design and print menus, business cards, flyers, brochures and banners, so your paper matches your website.

q: Do you run the ads, or do I?
a: We set them up and run them. The ad account is in your name and you pay Google or Instagram directly, so you always see where the money goes.

q: Can you promise first place on Google?
a: No, and nobody honestly can. What we can do is fix what holds your site back, keep your listing fresh and show you the numbers each month.

q: Will my business show up in ChatGPT and other AI tools?
a: We set up your site and listings so AI tools can read your name, address, hours, services and prices correctly. That gives you the best chance. No one can promise a spot in an AI answer.
